decision_scope: Surgical EXP-015-I1R source hunk and two boundary tests only

conditions: Transplant only the source hunk and two new tests onto the current integration branch; never replace the stale isolated test file wholesale.
Run affected and complete post-integration matrices and tests through the immutable attempt logger under the regenerated fingerprint.
Do not claim final-suite acceptance until those post-integration gates pass.
residual_risks: The raw latency benefit is modest and target-device specific even though the profile and launch-count benefit clears the declared gate.
Packed projection caching contributes to the optimized model's existing higher row-8 incremental peak-memory measurement.
Training, backward, low precision, compilation, CPU, widths 513 through 1023 except 1024, and widths above 1024 remain outside this route.
